test_cases.name: TC01_DeclarationSchemaAndCompactJson
test_cases.description: Verifies schemaVersion constant, compact JSON without BOM, and fixed field sequence.

test_cases.name: TC02_PolicyDeclarationRoundTrip
test_cases.description: Verifies full round-trip serialization and deserialization of typed policy declaration.

test_cases.name: TC03_DeterministicDigestAndEqualInstances
test_cases.description: Verifies identical digest for independent equal instances and culture invariance.

test_cases.name: TC04_OpaqueStringsWhitespacePreservation
test_cases.description: Verifies leading, trailing, and internal whitespace in policyId and revision are strictly preserved without Trim.

test_cases.name: TC05_OpaqueStringsUnicodeAndPunctuation
test_cases.description: Verifies lossless preservation of Unicode, quotes, backslashes, and punctuation in opaque identifiers.

test_cases.name: TC06_PackageIdsCaseNormalization
test_cases.description: Verifies invariant lowercase normalization of package IDs in declaration serialization.

test_cases.name: TC07_PermutationsDistinctDigests
test_cases.description: Verifies that isolated permutations of policyId, revision, list order, and multiplicity produce distinct digests.

test_cases.name: TC08_DigestOverloadParity
test_cases.description: Verifies that all ComputePackagePolicyDigest overloads route through canonical declaration producing identical digest.

test_cases.name: TC09_PureCheckPackagePolicyMatchingSuccess
test_cases.description: Verifies pure CheckPackagePolicy succeeds for matching positive manifest and declaration.

test_cases.name: TC10_PureTryAdmitWithPackagePolicySuccess
test_cases.description: Verifies pure TryAdmitWithPackagePolicy applies policy disposition and validates contract.

test_cases.name: TC11_CanonicalNormalizePreservesOpaquePolicyFields
test_cases.description: Verifies CanonicalNormalize does not Trim opaque policyId and revision fields.

test_cases.name: TC12_ContentContractAndCapabilityFlags
test_cases.description: Verifies ADR-006B-v5-R11 contract version and GATE05_R11_POLICY_ENCODING capability flag.

test_cases.name: TC13_Regression_R9_VersionMeaningSemantics
test_cases.description: Regresses R9 version meaning: modVersion null and empty values preserved without overwrite.

test_cases.name: TC14_Regression_DefFamiliesAndCanonicalSorting
test_cases.description: Regresses 8 Def families presence and canonical sorting order.
